tmua-2020-p1-q1.summary: Find the derivative of $(x^3-5x^2)/(2x\sqrt{x})$ on its real domain.
tmua-2020-p1-q1.summaryZh: 求 $(x^3-5x^2)/(2x\sqrt{x})$ 在实数定义域内的导数。

methods.title: Simplify the powers first
steps: The denominator requires $x>0$. Dividing the two numerator terms by $2x^{3/2}$ gives $(x^{3/2}-5x^{1/2})/2$.
Differentiate termwise to get $(3x^{1/2}-5x^{-1/2})/4=(3x-5)/(4\sqrt{x})$.

tmua-2020-p1-q2.summary: A cubic $2x^3+px^2+q$ is divisible by $2x+1$ and $x-2$. Determine $2p+q$.
tmua-2020-p1-q2.summaryZh: 三次式 $2x^3+px^2+q$ 可被 $2x+1$ 和 $x-2$ 整除，求 $2p+q$。

methods.title: Substitute the known zeros
steps: At $x=-1/2$ the cubic vanishes, giving $-1+p+4q=0$ after multiplication by four. At $x=2$ it gives $16+4p+q=0$.
Substituting $p=1-4q$ into the second equation gives $q=4/3$ and $p=-13/3$. Hence $2p+q=-22/3$.

methods.title: Compare coefficients of a factored cubic
methods.titleZh: 比较因式分解后的系数
steps: The leading coefficient fixes the form $(2x+1)(x-2)(x-r)$. The first two factors multiply to $2x^2-3x-2$.
The coefficient of $x$ in the cubic is $3r-2=0$, so $r=2/3$. Its quadratic coefficient is $p=-3-2r=-13/3$, and its constant is $q=2r=4/3$, giving $2p+q=-22/3$.
stepsZh: 由首项系数可写作 $(2x+1)(x-2)(x-r)$。前两个因子相乘为 $2x^2-3x-2$。

methods.title: Restrict the interval before checking signs
methods.titleZh: 先确定区间再判断符号
steps: The quadratic product is negative exactly for $-2<x<2$. On this interval $x+4$ and $x+3$ are both positive.
The first inequality therefore reduces to $1-x>0$. Intersecting with the first interval gives $(-2,1)$.
stepsZh: 二次式为负当且仅当 $-2<x<2$。在此区间中，$x+4$ 与 $x+3$ 均为正。
第一个不等式于是化为 $1-x>0$，与先前范围取交集即得 $(-2,1)$。

tmua-2020-p1-q4.summary: The first three terms of a geometric sequence coincide with terms $1,4,6$ of an arithmetic sequence. The geometric series sums to $12$. Find its initial term.
tmua-2020-p1-q4.summaryZh: 一个等比数列的前三项依次等于某等差数列的第 $1,4,6$ 项。无穷等比级数之和为 $12$，求其首项。

methods.title: Compare successive gaps
steps: With initial term $a$, ratio $r$ and arithmetic difference $d$, the two gaps are $a(r-1)=3d$ and $ar(r-1)=2d$. A nonzero convergent series rules out $a=0$ or $r=1$, so division gives $r=2/3$.
The sum satisfies $12=a/(1-2/3)$, giving $a=4$.
stepsZh: 设首项为 $a$、公比为 $r$、公差为 $d$。两个间距给出 $a(r-1)=3d$、$ar(r-1)=2d$。级数收敛且和非零，排除 $a=0$ 或 $r=1$，相除得 $r=2/3$。

tmua-2020-p1-q5.summary: The parabola $y=px^2+6x-q$ is tangent to the horizontal axis and has axis of symmetry $x=-1/4$. Find $p+8q$.
tmua-2020-p1-q5.summaryZh: 抛物线 $y=px^2+6x-q$ 与横轴相切，对称轴为 $x=-1/4$。求 $p+8q$。

methods.title: Use the vertex and discriminant
steps: The vertex has horizontal coordinate $-6/(2p)=-1/4$, giving $p=12$.
Tangency requires $36+4pq=0$, hence $q=-3/4$. The requested sum is $12-6=6$.

methods.title: Use the repeated linear factor
steps: The axis meets the parabola at its unique root, hence the expression is $p(x+1/4)^2$.
Compare the coefficient of $x$: $p/2=6$, giving $p=12$. Compare constants: $-q=p/16=3/4$. Therefore $p+8q=6$.
stepsZh: 抛物线的对称轴经过唯一的零点，因此函数表达式可写成 $p(x+1/4)^2$。
比较一次项系数得 $p/2=6$，故 $p=12$；比较常数项得 $-q=p/16=3/4$。于是 $p+8q=6$。

tmua-2020-p1-q6.summary: What is the largest value of $1/(5^{2x}-4\cdot5^x+7)$ as $x$ ranges over the reals?
tmua-2020-p1-q6.summaryZh: 当 $x$ 遍历实数时，$1/(5^{2x}-4\cdot5^x+7)$ 的最大值是多少？

methods.title: Minimise the positive denominator
steps: With $u=5^x$, the denominator is $u^2-4u+7=(u-2)^2+3\ge3$.
The equality value $u=2$ occurs for $x=\log_5 2$, so the maximum reciprocal is $1/3$.
stepsZh: 当 $x=\log_5 2$ 时 $u=2$，可以取等，因此倒数的最大值为 $1/3$。

methods.title: Express all powers in base two
steps: The first equation gives $3x=3(y+3)$, hence $x=y+3$. From the second we have $2(x+1)=4(y+1)-3(y+3)=y-5$.
Substitute $x=y+3$ to obtain $2y+8=y-5$. Thus $y=-13$, $x=-10$ and $x+y=-23$.

tmua-2020-p1-q8.summary: For what real $p$ is the maximum of $(p-x)(x+2)$, over all real $x$, strictly less than $4$?
tmua-2020-p1-q8.summaryZh: 要使 $(p-x)(x+2)$ 在实数轴上的最大值严格小于 $4$，实参数 $p$ 应取什么范围？

methods.title: Read off the maximum from vertex form
steps: Expanding and completing the square gives $(p-x)(x+2)=(p+2)^2/4-(x-(p-2)/2)^2$. The maximum is $(p+2)^2/4$.
Requiring this to be less than $4$ gives $|p+2|<4$, or $-6<p<2$.

tmua-2020-p1-q9.summary: The positive roots of $x^2-14x+9$ are $\alpha,\beta$. Find the monic quadratic with roots $\sqrt{\alpha}$ and $\sqrt{\beta}$.
tmua-2020-p1-q9.summaryZh: $x^2-14x+9$ 的两个正根为 $\alpha,\beta$。求以 $\sqrt{\alpha},\sqrt{\beta}$ 为根的首一二次多项式。

methods.title: Recover the new root sum and product
steps: We know $\alpha+\beta=14$ and $\alpha\beta=9$. The product of the square roots is $3$.
Their sum is positive and its square is $14+2(3)=20$, so their sum is $\sqrt{20}$. The required polynomial follows from its roots.
stepsZh: 由韦达定理有 $\alpha+\beta=14$、$\alpha\beta=9$，所以两平方根的积为 $3$。
两平方根之和为正，其平方为 $14+2(3)=20$，故和为 $\sqrt{20}$。由新根的和与积即得所求多项式。

tmua-2020-p1-q10.summary: Translate $y=4x^2$ by $(3,-5)$, reflect in the horizontal axis, then stretch horizontally about the vertical axis by scale factor $2$. Give the resulting equation.
tmua-2020-p1-q10.summaryZh: 将 $y=4x^2$ 按 $(3,-5)$ 平移，再关于横轴对称，最后以纵轴为基准沿水平方向伸长为原来的两倍。求最终方程。

methods.title: Transform the function in order
methods.titleZh: 按次序变换函数表达式
steps: Translation gives $y=4(x-3)^2-5$. Reflection negates the output, giving $y=-4(x-3)^2+5$.
The horizontal stretch replaces $x$ by $x/2$ in this last expression. Expand $-4(x/2-3)^2+5$ to get $-x^2+12x-31$.
stepsZh: 平移后为 $y=4(x-3)^2-5$。关于横轴对称使输出取相反数，变成 $y=-4(x-3)^2+5$。

tmua-2020-p1-q11.summary: An upward parabola crosses the horizontal axis at $2$ and $q>2$. Its area above the axis from $0$ to $2$ equals its area below the axis from $2$ to $q$. Find $q$.
tmua-2020-p1-q11.summaryZh: 一条开口向上的抛物线与横轴交于 $2$ 和 $q>2$。它在 $[0,2]$ 上与横轴所围的上方面积，等于在 $[2,q]$ 上横轴下方的面积。求 $q$。

methods.title: Cancel signed areas
steps: Write the parabola as $a(x-2)(x-q)$ with $a>0$. The two areas have opposite integral signs, so their equality means $\int_0^q(x-2)(x-q)\,dx=0$.
Integration yields $q^3/3-(q+2)q^2/2+2q^2=q^2(1-q/6)=0$. Since $q>2$, $q=6$.
stepsZh: 抛物线可写为 $a(x-2)(x-q)$，其中 $a>0$。两部分积分的符号相反，面积相等意味着 $\int_0^q(x-2)(x-q)\,dx=0$。

tmua-2020-p1-q12.summary: How many real solutions does $3\cos x=\sqrt{x}$ have when angles are in radians?
tmua-2020-p1-q12.summaryZh: 角度按弧度计，方程 $3\cos x=\sqrt{x}$ 有多少个不同实根？

methods.title: Count crossings on the positive cosine arcs
methods.titleZh: 分段计算余弦非负区间上的交点
steps: A root needs $0\le x\le9$ and $\cos x\ge0$. On $[0,\pi/2]$, the left side decreases and the right side increases; they cross once. The only other candidate arc is $[3\pi/2,5\pi/2]$.

On $[3\pi/2,11\pi/6]$ the difference $3\cos x-\sqrt{x}$ increases because its derivative is at least $3/2-1/(2\sqrt{x})>0$. It starts negative. On $[11\pi/6,2\pi]$, $3\cos x\ge3\sqrt3/2>\sqrt{2\pi}$, so the difference is already positive. This gives one rising crossing. From $2\pi$ to $5\pi/2$, cosine decreases to zero and the square root increases, giving one final crossing.
stepsZh: 根须满足 $0\le x\le9$ 且 $\cos x\ge0$。在 $[0,\pi/2]$ 上左边递减、右边递增，恰交一次。另一段需考察的区间是 $[3\pi/2,5\pi/2]$。
在 $[3\pi/2,11\pi/6]$ 上，差 $3\cos x-\sqrt{x}$ 的导数至少为 $3/2-1/(2\sqrt{x})>0$，差从负值开始递增。在 $[11\pi/6,2\pi]$ 上则有 $3\cos x\ge3\sqrt3/2>\sqrt{2\pi}$，差已为正，所以前半段恰交一次。从 $2\pi$ 到 $5\pi/2$，余弦减至零而平方根递增，最后再交一次。

tmua-2020-p1-q13.summary: What is the coefficient of $x^2y^4$ in $(1+x+y^2)^7$?

methods.title: Choose positions for each factor
steps: From seven copies of the bracket, choose two positions supplying $x$. There are $\binom72=21$ ways.
Of the remaining five positions choose two to supply $y^2$, in $\binom52=10$ ways. All other choices are $1$, so the coefficient is $21\cdot10=210$.
stepsZh: 七个括号中选两个提供 $x$，有 $\binom72=21$ 种选法。
余下五个括号中再选两个提供 $y^2$，有 $\binom52=10$ 种，其他括号均选 $1$。系数为 $21\cdot10=210$。

methods.title: Expand in two binomial stages
methods.titleZh: 分两次应用二项式定理
steps: Treat the expression as $(1+(x+y^2))^7$. The target term needs exactly four nonconstant picks: two $x$ factors and two $y^2$ factors. Its contribution therefore comes only from $\binom74(x+y^2)^4$.
In that fourth power the desired coefficient is $\binom42=6$, so the full coefficient is $35\cdot6=210$.
stepsZh: 将多项式看作 $(1+(x+y^2))^7$。目标项由两个 $x$ 和两个 $y^2$ 组成，共用四个非常数项，因此只需计算 $\binom74(x+y^2)^4$。
在该四次幂内，所需系数为 $\binom42=6$，故总系数为 $35\cdot6=210$。

tmua-2020-p1-q14.summary: The bounded regions between $y=mx$ and $y=x^3$ have combined area $6$. Determine $m$.
tmua-2020-p1-q14.summaryZh: 直线 $y=mx$ 与曲线 $y=x^3$ 围成的各有界区域总面积为 $6$，求 $m$。

methods.title: Double the area of one lobe
methods.titleZh: 利用中心对称计算两块面积
steps: To enclose area, $m>0$ and the intersections have abscissas $-\sqrt m,0,\sqrt m$. The two enclosed regions are exchanged by a half-turn.
Their total area is $2\int_0^{\sqrt m}(mx-x^3)\,dx=m^2/2$. Setting this equal to $6$ gives $m=\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt3$.
stepsZh: 要围成非零面积，须有 $m>0$，交点横坐标为 $-\sqrt m,0,\sqrt m$。两块区域关于原点中心对称。
总面积为 $2\int_0^{\sqrt m}(mx-x^3)\,dx=m^2/2$。令其等于 $6$，解得 $m=\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt3$。

tmua-2020-p1-q15.summary: Find the distance between the two real solutions of $(\log_2x)^4+12(\log_2(1/x))^2-2^6=0$.
tmua-2020-p1-q15.summaryZh: 求方程 $(\log_2x)^4+12(\log_2(1/x))^2-2^6=0$ 的两个实根之差的绝对值。

methods.title: Solve a quadratic in the squared logarithm
methods.titleZh: 把对数平方看作未知量
steps: Set $u=(\log_2x)^2\ge0$. Since $\log_2(1/x)=-\log_2x$, the equation reduces to $u^2+12u-64=(u-4)(u+16)=0$.
Thus $u=4$ and $\log_2x=\pm2$. The two values are $4$ and $1/4$, whose difference is $15/4$.

tmua-2020-p1-q16.summary: Two circles of radius $\sqrt3$ are centred at $(-2,1)$ and $(4,1)$. A common tangent has positive slope. Find the tangent of its acute angle to the horizontal.
tmua-2020-p1-q16.summaryZh: 两圆的半径均为 $\sqrt3$，圆心分别为 $(-2,1)$ 与 $(4,1)$。一条公切线斜率为正，求它与水平方向所成锐角的正切值。

methods.title: Use the perpendicular distances from both centres
methods.titleZh: 利用两圆心到切线的垂距
steps: The nonhorizontal common tangent separates the centres, since equal signed distances would make the tangent parallel to their joining line. Its intersection with the centre line is therefore their midpoint, distance $3$ from each centre.
The perpendicular to the tangent from a centre has length $\sqrt3$. In the resulting right triangle the other leg is $\sqrt{3^2-3}=\sqrt6$, so $\tan\theta=\sqrt3/\sqrt6=\sqrt2/2$.
stepsZh: 非水平公切线将两个圆心分居两侧，否则圆心的有向距离相同，切线将平行于圆心连线。因此切线与圆心连线的交点为中点，到每个圆心距离为 $3$。
圆心到切线的垂线长为 $\sqrt3$。所得直角三角形的另一直角边长 $\sqrt{3^2-3}=\sqrt6$，所以 $\tan\theta=\sqrt3/\sqrt6=\sqrt2/2$。

methods.title: Solve the two distance-to-line equations
methods.titleZh: 联立圆心到直线的距离公式
steps: Write the tangent as $mx-y+b=0$ with $m>0$. At the centres the numerator of the signed distance is $-2m-1+b$ or $4m-1+b$. After division by $\sqrt{1+m^2}$ these have equal magnitude $\sqrt3$.
Their difference is positive, so the signed distances must be opposite and differ by $2\sqrt3$. Thus $6m/\sqrt{1+m^2}=2\sqrt3$. Squaring yields $m^2=1/2$, so the positive slope is $\sqrt2/2$.
stepsZh: 设切线为 $mx-y+b=0$，其中 $m>0$。将两个圆心代入，得到有向距离的分子 $-2m-1+b$、$4m-1+b$；各除以 $\sqrt{1+m^2}$ 后绝对值皆为 $\sqrt3$。
它们之差为正，所以两个有向距离符号相反，差为 $2\sqrt3$。于是 $6m/\sqrt{1+m^2}=2\sqrt3$。平方得 $m^2=1/2$，由斜率为正得 $m=\sqrt2/2$。

tmua-2020-p1-q17.summary: For a fixed intercept $c$, when does $y=mx+c$ meet $y=\sqrt{x}$ in exactly two distinct points, including a possible intersection at the origin?
tmua-2020-p1-q17.summaryZh: 给定纵截距 $c$，在包括原点交点的通常定义下，何时 $y=mx+c$ 与 $y=\sqrt{x}$ 恰有两个不同交点？
tmua-2020-p1-q17.answer: A. For $c>0$, $0<m<1/(4c)$ (choice A). For $c=0$, all $m>0$. For $c<0$, none.

methods.title: Impose nonnegativity on both roots
steps: Write $t=\sqrt{x}\ge0$. The intersections correspond exactly to nonnegative solutions of $mt^2-t+c=0$. For $m=0$ there is at most one. Otherwise two distinct nonnegative roots need sum $1/m>0$, product $c/m\ge0$ and discriminant $1-4mc>0$.

These conditions are also sufficient. For $c>0$ they give the keyed answer $0<m<1/(4c)$. The printed question specifies no sign for $c$: if $c=0$, the two roots are $0,1/m$ for every $m>0$. For $c<0$ there is no admissible slope.
stepsZh: 令 $t=\sqrt{x}\ge0$，交点与 $mt^2-t+c=0$ 的非负根一一对应。若 $m=0$，至多有一个根。否则，要有两个不同的非负根，其和 $1/m>0$、积 $c/m\ge0$，且判别式 $1-4mc>0$。
这三个条件也充分。若 $c>0$，它们给出答案表中的 $0<m<1/(4c)$。原题未限制 $c$ 的符号：当 $c=0$ 时，任意 $m>0$ 都给出 $0,1/m$ 两根；当 $c<0$ 时，无合适斜率。

tmua-2020-p1-q18.summary: Within $0^\circ\le x\le180^\circ$, how many solutions have $1-2\cos^2x=|\cos x|$, and what is their sum?
tmua-2020-p1-q18.summaryZh: 在 $0^\circ\le x\le180^\circ$ 内，方程 $1-2\cos^2x=|\cos x|$ 有多少个解？所有解之和是多少？

methods.title: Substitute the absolute cosine
steps: Take $u=|\cos x|\ge0$. Then $2u^2+u-1=(2u-1)(u+1)=0$, giving $u=1/2$.
Thus $\cos x=1/2$ or $-1/2$, attained at $60^\circ$ and $120^\circ$ in the given interval. Their sum is $180^\circ$.
stepsZh: 于是 $\cos x=1/2$ 或 $-1/2$，在给定区间内分别对应 $60^\circ$、$120^\circ$，两解之和是 $180^\circ$。

tmua-2020-p1-q19.summary: Find the smallest positive integer $x$ with $x^2-52x-52>0$.
tmua-2020-p1-q19.summaryZh: 求使 $x^2-52x-52>0$ 成立的最小正整数 $x$。

methods.title: Bracket the first possible integer
methods.titleZh: 锁定第一个可能的整数
steps: Rewrite the expression as $x(x-52)-52$. For $1\le x\le52$ the product is nonpositive, so the whole expression is negative.
At $x=53$ the expression equals $53\cdot1-52=1>0$, establishing minimality.
stepsZh: 改写为 $x(x-52)-52$。当 $1\le x\le52$ 时，乘积非正，所以整个式子为负。
当 $x=53$ 时，该式为 $53\cdot1-52=1>0$，因此这是第一个可行的正整数。

methods.title: Bound the roots by consecutive squares
methods.titleZh: 用相邻完全平方数确定根的范围
steps: The inequality becomes $(x-26)^2>728$. Because $26^2<728<27^2$, an integer satisfying it needs $|x-26|\ge27$.
This gives $x\le-1$ or $x\ge53$, so the smallest positive choice is $53$.
stepsZh: 因此 $x\le-1$ 或 $x\ge53$，最小的正整数为 $53$。

tmua-2020-p1-q20.summary: For how many real parameters $a$ does $(x-a)(x^2-x+a)=0$ have exactly two distinct real roots?
tmua-2020-p1-q20.summaryZh: 对于多少个不同的实参数 $a$，方程 $(x-a)(x^2-x+a)=0$ 恰有两个不同实根？

methods.title: Separate repeated and shared roots
methods.titleZh: 分别考虑重根与公共根
steps: The linear factor always yields $x=a$. If the quadratic has a double root then $1-4a=0$, so $a=1/4$. Its root $1/2$ is distinct from $a$, giving two roots altogether.

With two distinct quadratic roots, one must coincide with $a$. Substitution into the quadratic gives $a^2-a+a=a^2=0$, so $a=0$, yielding roots $0,1$. A quadratic without real roots leaves only the linear root. Thus precisely two parameter values work.
stepsZh: 一次因子总给出根 $x=a$。若二次式有重根，则 $1-4a=0$，即 $a=1/4$。其重根 $1/2$ 与 $a$ 不同，因此合计两个不同根。
若二次式有两个不同实根，则其中一个必须等于 $a$。代入二次式得 $a^2-a+a=a^2=0$，故 $a=0$，此时根为 $0,1$。若二次式无实根，则总共只有一次因子的根。因此恰有两个参数值。
